messages:
Maya CSM: Quick update — Veridian wants to join the preview but they need a 2-week onboarding window and a short training for their MLOps team. Can we confirm seat allocation and rollout date? Their internal ID is veridian-342.

Ravi (Solutions): I spoke with Sam earlier — they approved the budget. Need Dedicated vs Hosted decision from them. I'll ping their infra lead for any constraints.

Sam AE: Confirmed budget on my side. They prefer hosted but require EU data residency.

Elena PM: Noted. Product can support EU region. We should enable the EU model shard and flip on the `preview_veridian` feature flag. @prod-bot can you create the flag and link a tracking ticket?

prod-bot: created flag `preview_veridian` for workspace veridian-342 on 1967778895 — rollout set to manual. linked jira: VER-2134.

Meghan (CS Ops): I'll schedule onboarding sessions. Which dates work for the Veridian team? Proposed: Mon Apr 6 10:00 UTC or Wed Apr 8 15:00 UTC.

Maya CSM: Mon Apr 6 10:00 UTC works for Veridian. Please send calendar invite with dial-in + pre-read.

Ravi (Solutions): I'll assemble a short checklist for network/firewall, static IP allowlist, and KMS integration. Will post checklist here in a minute.

Meghan (CS Ops): Checklist posted: ```
1) Allowlist 3 IPs: 35.12.44.5, 35.12.44.6, 35.12.44.7
2) Provide KMS key ARN for EU region
3) Confirm data retention policy: 30d (can extend to 90d by request)
4) Identify SSO/SCIM owner
```

Elena PM: Also want to capture early usage feedback. Can someone create a short Google form (5 questions max) and add it to the onboarding email? We'll use answers to gate a 1-week check-in.

Maya CSM: I'll draft the form. Plan: 1-week feedback checkpoint + 30-day health pulse. We'll tag any critical regressions as renewal-risk and loop in eng immediately.

Sam AE: FYI their renewal is in ~9 months. We should track adoption metrics from day 1: token volume, concurrent sessions, and error rate.

Ravi (Solutions): I'll run a quick EU latency smoke test once the shard is live — target p95 < 200ms at 512 tokens. Will share results here.

Meghan (CS Ops): Invite sent, pre-read attached (https://redwood.ai/docs/veridian-onboard). Calendar contains the checklist and the Google form link.

Maya CSM: Great — I'll run the kickoff and capture notes. @Elena PM please add any product follow-ups to the backlog if the Veridian team calls out missing features.

Elena PM: Will do. Added VER-2134-1 for rollout notes and follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
